contentBlocks.body: Some operations can throw, like JSON.parse on malformed text. Wrap risky work in a try block and handle the failure in catch so one bad input does not crash the whole program.

knowledgeItems.prompt: What runs when code inside a try block throws?

payload.explanation: A thrown error transfers control to the matching catch block.

knowledgeItems.prompt: Parse the JSON text and return the value; return an empty object {} if the text is not valid JSON.
